comparison.objective: Hold a dial thermometer's sensing area submerged in an ice-point setup, clear of glass, for 30 seconds; candidate fractures insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed immersion with clearance control versus coaxial tool stabilization, impact-force control and tiny-object recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Sensing area remains submerged, avoids glass and satisfies a 30-second dwell; candidate requires four fractures, containment and a two-second stable final state.
comparison.reason: Both include careful positioning and dwell, but the central physical outcomes—measurement placement versus notch fracture—are different.
